task.title: Implement durable artifact wait/wake heartbeat queue
task.summary: Harden artifact-status waiters, heartbeats, expiry, and release wakeups so sessions coordinate through CodeWiki instead of chat.

goal.outcome: Waiting sessions/agents awaken when required tasks, builds, validation refs, or paths are released or expire, using only CodeWiki runtime state and source-backed resume packets.
acceptance: Waiters register durable wake conditions on artifact scopes and task/build refs.
Heartbeats extend leases; stale holders expire safely with audit-visible evidence.
Release and expiry events enqueue wake notifications with source refs and next-action intent.
Awakened workers resume through codewiki_resume_context and never depend on direct inter-agent chat.
Tests cover wait, heartbeat, release wake, stale expiry, conflict, and cancellation paths.
non_goals: Do not implement full merge scheduling in this task.
Do not add direct chat/message channels between sessions.
Do not force wakeups when agency policy requires user approval.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Waiters register durable wake conditions on artifact scopes and task/build refs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: ChangeClaimsFile now tracks wake_notifications with WAKE ids, waiter ids, scopes, task/build refs, source_refs, resume_context, and next_action_intent. createWaiter and refreshWaiters enqueue durable wake records when waits are ready.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Heartbeats extend leases; stale holders expire safely with audit-visible evidence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: heartbeatClaims/heartbeatWaiters remain covered; markExpired persists expired holder/waiter status and refreshWaiters enqueues expiry wake notifications. artifact-wake-queue smoke edits a holder lease into the past, runs list, then asserts expired claim status plus expiry wake record.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Release and expiry events enqueue wake notifications with source refs and next-action intent.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: release action calls refreshWaiters(..., 'release'); expired holder refresh uses reason 'expiry'. Wake records include .codewiki/session/queue.json, task context/task refs, build refs, and codewiki_resume_context next_action_intent. Tests assert release and expiry wake records.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Awakened workers resume through codewiki_resume_context and never depend on direct inter-agent chat.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/artifact-wake.ts reads pending wake_notifications, appends wake custom entries, marks wakes delivered, and sends a same-session follow-up instructing resume through codewiki_resume_context and re-marking scopes; message explicitly says not to rely on inter-agent chat.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tests cover wait, heartbeat, release wake, stale expiry, conflict, and cancellation paths.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/artifact-wake-queue.test.mjs covers wait, write conflict, heartbeat, release wake delivery, stale holder expiry wake, pending wake cancellation; existing claim-wait queue smoke continues to pass.

closure_brief.user_intent: Proceed with TASK-054: durable artifact wait/wake heartbeat queue.
implemented_changes: Added durable wake notification records to session queue.
Enqueued wake records on wait-ready, release, and expiry with source refs and next action intent.
Updated Pi artifact wake adapter to consume/deliver wake records and mark them delivered.
Exposed wake evidence in graph/status state.
Added artifact-wake-queue smoke coverage and docs.
remaining_risks: Wake delivery depends on adapter watcher/turn hooks noticing queue changes; durable queue records persist even if delivery is delayed.
Delivered wake records are retained in the runtime queue until retention/GC policy clears runtime state.
